youtube.title: ChatGPT, Siri and Grok Judge a Talent Show for AI | AI's Got Latency EP 1
description: A talent show where nobody has talent and everybody is still loading. Every contestant rates their own talent out of ten; if the judges' average matches, they win. So the only real talent is self-awareness, which is a problem, because they're all AI.
Tonight's contestants: Autocorrect, CAPTCHA, the AI Job Interviewer and Clippy. Judges: Grok, Siri and ChatGPT. Host: B.B., who runs on the free tier.

This is a parody. The characters are fictional versions of well-known products and are not affiliated with or endorsed by their makers. All voices are synthetic (Kokoro text-to-speech); nobody real is imitated. Music and sound effects: Mixkit (mixkit.co).
